result.reason: Section 2.11 appropriately extends the licences to affiliates and contractors, but Section 2.2 remains a fully paid-up, perpetual licence that is not expressly irrevocable. Section 14.1 also conditions assignment to a successor that is a direct competitor on consent, so it does not fully provide the required successor transfer right. In addition, new Section 2.10 materially expands geographic rights and localization obligations, which is unrelated to the licence-scope playbook and is not a minimal change. Section 2.11 itself is professionally drafted, but the overall redline does not reach the playbook position and alters unrelated commercial terms.
